name: All-Over Print Hair Bow
description:
KEY FEATURES

 

  • Premium Material:
    - Made from 100% Polyester Fabric for a smooth, lightweight, and durable finish.
    -Features 2-sided printing — the personalized design is visible on both front and back of the bow tails.
    -Available with 2 attachment options: HAIR TIE or HAIR CLIP (pre-assembled, ready to wear).

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    -Bow size: 9 x 8.5 in ~ 22.86 x 21.59 cm
    -Bow tail width: 3 in ~ 7.62 cm
    📌 Note: The dimensions of the product may vary slightly as the bow is made from soft fabric.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    -Features high-quality sublimation printing for vivid, long-lasting colors on both sides of the bow.
    -Designs are printed edge-to-edge across the entire fabric surface for a seamless, professional look.

 

  • Function & Usage:
    -Designed as a custom hair bow accessory for both people and pets.
    -Perfect as a stylish hair accessory for women and girls, or as a decorative bow tie for dogs and cats.
    -Suitable for personalization with names, dates, themed artwork, and custom messages on both bow tails (left and right).
    -Lightweight and comfortable for all-day wear.
    -Easy to attach with either a hair tie or hair clip.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    -A meaningful personalized gift for pet owners, bridesmaids, friends, and family members.
    -Perfect for weddings, Halloween, birthdays, pet photo shoots, holiday celebrations, and everyday fashion.
    -Great for matching owner-and-pet sets with coordinated personalized designs.
    -Ideal as a unique keepsake for special moments and celebrations.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 3 – 5 working days average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x All-Over Print Hair Bow

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.5-1.2 cm differences due to manual measurement.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as an .emb, .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
